name: compact-priority-truncation
note: A summary budget too small for everything must spend it on the goal, not on the transcript, and must say it was cut. Render order is priority order for exactly this case: a lookup can be run again, while the goal cannot be recovered by any tool call. The turn still has to finish — a budget that failed the turn would make a small window unusable.
